Author: Ross Buckley
Message:
Security boundaries: five confirmed risks fixed with adversarial tests

Adversarial tests were run on unmodified main (c27289e) first: all five fail there
(symlink escape, POST re-sent by healing, GET executing a writing goal, unannotated
MCP tool runnable as safe, agent confirm treated as approval). Two further risks
reviewed were not present (credential forwarding, network-policy consistency).

- workspace paths judged by real path; no writes through symlinks
- GET /x/<slug> only for read-only goals (405 + Allow: POST); OpenAPI declares POST
- state-changing steps that may have taken effect are never re-sent or routed around,
  unless the error proves non-application or the operator declares the operation
  side-effect-free (authority.retry / RCX_RETRY); composites inspected step by step
- MCP risk follows the spec's defaults (unannotated = destructive)
- operator authority outside the agent: authority.destructive operator (default)
  | agent-confirm | allow, authority.approve; RCX_DESTRUCTIVE / RCX_APPROVE

Ported on its own from c90b24d on feature/universal-capability-engine; none of that
branch's investigation or goal-satisfaction work is included. Existing tests changed
only to state the operator authority they rely on. README's execution-risk bullet
updated to match. 121/121 tests, typecheck, build, labs 30/30 x2, negative
controls 6/6, proof 28/28. Record: experiments/security-boundaries/RECORD.md

Message:
Stage 5: goal satisfaction - plans judged by what their result carries (pre-registered model)

Implements the model pre-registered in experiments/goal-satisfaction/PREREGISTRATION.md
(1e191f8, before implementation):
- reflectors record contract-declared result fields (OpenAPI through arrays/objects;
  GraphQL three levels with default-selection flags) - core/fields.ts
- core/satisfaction.ts: required terms covered by the result's declared fields; joins
  classified caller / evidence (learned scheme) / declared (specific type) / generic;
  status established / unverified / incomplete
- planner: required information counts as progress (json -> json); ranking by status,
  then coverage; extensions that improve coverage are not pruned
- compose(require): only established plans run, else an explicit unavailable/unverified
  outcome and nothing runs; GraphQL fields declared but unselected are projected into the
  selection automatically; after running, the output is checked for every term
- context_compose gains the require parameter (no new tool)
Regression tests: test/goal-satisfaction.test.ts (5). 138/138, labs 30/30 x2,
negative controls 6/6, proof 28/28.

  | agent-confirm | allow, authority.approve; RCX_DESTRUCTIVE / RCX_APPROVE
